description: A chunky low-poly light tank parked on the ground, seen from the front-left, built with many small separate faceted parts like a detailed game unit. A short compact boxy hull with a steep sloped front plate carrying two small tow hooks at its lower edge and two small flat headlight blocks each inside a small cage guard, a thin flat track guard over each track with no side skirts, and a flat rear engine deck with one raised rectangular grille box made of parallel slats. A small rounded angular turret set a little forward of the middle with a short mantlet block and a medium-length gun barrel pointing straight forward past the nose with a small muzzle collar; on the turret roof a small square hatch with a hinged lid and a small periscope block in front of it; a cluster of three short smoke-grenade launcher tubes on each front corner of the turret, angled forward and up. Along each side a track loop of clearly separate segmented track links over five road wheels each with a raised round hub cap, two small return rollers along the top run of the track, a toothed drive sprocket at the front end and a smooth idler at the rear end. Hull, turret, hatch, track guards and grille box painted one desert tan; gun barrel, mantlet, smoke launchers, tow hooks, headlight guards, tracks, road wheels, return rollers, sprocket and idler dark gunmetal grey, hub caps a slightly lighter grey; headlight lenses pale tan. The engine grille on the rear face faces away and is hidden; the right-hand track and right-hand smoke launchers are hidden behind the hull and turret.
proportions: About 6.5 m long including the gun, 2.9 m wide and 2.3 m tall; the five road wheels, return rollers and track links clearly visible. (length : width : height = 2.24 : 1 : 0.79)
sides: the light tank is symmetric left to right; the turret, its hatch and periscope block sit on the centre line and the gun points straight forward. Five road wheels per side, no side skirts.
